items.label: text
items.text: Ring main circuits usually consist of three wires-the live wire,the neutral wire and theearthwire.

items.label: text
items.text: The live wireprovides thepathalongwhich the electrical energyfrom the power station travels.The neutral wire completesthe circuit.

items.label: text
items.text: Theearth wire usuallyhasno current in it.lt is there toprotectyou if an escape without passing through the user.

items.label: text
items.text: Ring main circuits provide a way ofallowing several appliances in different parts of the same room to be connected to the mainsusing theminimum amount ofwiring. Imagine howmuch wire would beneeded if there wasjust one mains socket in each room.
